name: Ownership or controllers linked to designated or previously reported parties
description: Owners, officers or associates match sanctions or designation lists, prior suspicious reports or adverse media.
fp: Name similarities produce false matches; verify identifiers such as date of birth and address.

links.name: Entities and individuals linked to sanctioned networks
links.ctx: Customer matches or is linked to designated persons or front entities in public lists.

links.name: Linked parties with previous suspicious reports or designation
links.ctx: Operator, owners or agents match prior reports, adverse media or designation lists.

links.name: Beneficial owners, trustees or signatories linked to concerning persons
links.ctx: Officers, trustees or major donors appear in adverse media, sanctions or terrorist designation data, or share details with previously reported entities.
